units.title: SG-1.1 Define the shared palette and 480x270 render constants
Act: Create the shared palette module
Act: Export palette Tailwind colours and register them in tailwind.config.ts
Act: Switch config.ts to 480x270 and guard computeZoom against invalid dpr

tests.name: tests/palette.test.ts > palette module > has at most 48 unique hex colours
tests.title: has at most 48 unique hex colours
tests.scenario: Given the shared PALETTE list, When its length and entries are checked, Then it has at most 48 entries, no duplicates, and every entry is a lowercase #rrggbb hex colour
tests.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/palette.test.ts --testTimeout=10000

tests.name: tests/palette.test.ts > palette module > names warm and cool ramps
tests.title: names warm and cool ramps
tests.scenario: Given WARM_RAMPS and COOL_RAMPS, When compared with PALETTE_RAMPS keys, Then every warm and cool name is a ramp key, the two lists share no name, and together they cover all ramp keys
tests.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/palette.test.ts --testTimeout=10000

units.title: Verify: Palette Tailwind colour export unit tests

tests.name: paletteTailwindColors
tests.title: flattens to every palette colour once
tests.scenario: Given paletteTailwindColors is built from PALETTE_RAMPS, When every ramp's colour values are flattened, Then the sorted result equals the sorted PALETTE list
tests.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/paletteTailwind.test.ts --testTimeout=10000

tests.name: tailwind.config pal
tests.title: registers the palette ramps under theme.extend.colors.pal and keeps the background token
tests.scenario: Given the default export of tailwind.config.ts, When its theme.extend.colors is read, Then pal equals paletteTailwindColors and background is 'hsl(var(--background))'
tests.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/paletteTailwind.test.ts --testTimeout=10000

units.title: Verify: 480x270 constants and computeZoom unit tests

tests.name: tests/computeZoom.test.ts > computeZoom whole-number scaling > returns the integer zoom 1280 x 720 at dpr 1 as 2
tests.title: returns the integer zoom 1280 x 720 at dpr 1 as 2
tests.scenario: Given viewport 1280x720 and dpr 1, When computeZoom runs, Then zoom is 2 and an integer
tests.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/computeZoom.test.ts --testTimeout=10000

tests.title: returns the integer zoom 1920 x 1080 at dpr 2 as 8

tests.title: returns the integer zoom 1366 x 768 at dpr 1 as 2
tests.scenario: Given viewport 1366x768 and dpr 1, When computeZoom runs, Then zoom is 2 and an integer
tests.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/computeZoom.test.ts --testTimeout=10000

tests.name: tests/computeZoom.test.ts > computeZoom whole-number scaling > returns the integer zoom 1280 x 720 at dpr 1.5 as 4
tests.title: returns the integer zoom 1280 x 720 at dpr 1.5 as 4
tests.scenario: Given viewport 1280x720 and dpr 1.5, When computeZoom runs, Then zoom is 4 and an integer
tests.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/computeZoom.test.ts --testTimeout=10000

tests.name: tests/computeZoom.test.ts > computeZoom whole-number scaling > returns the integer zoom 1000 x 600 at dpr 2 as 4
tests.title: returns the integer zoom 1000 x 600 at dpr 2 as 4
tests.scenario: Given viewport 1000x600 and dpr 2, When computeZoom runs, Then zoom is 4 and an integer
tests.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/computeZoom.test.ts --testTimeout=10000

tests.name: tests/computeZoom.test.ts > computeZoom whole-number scaling > returns the integer zoom 479 x 269 at dpr 1 as 1
tests.title: returns the integer zoom 479 x 269 at dpr 1 as 1
tests.scenario: Given viewport 479x269 (below native 480x270) and dpr 1, When computeZoom runs, Then zoom clamps to 1

tests.name: tests/computeZoom.test.ts > computeZoom whole-number scaling > falls back to dpr 1 when dpr is 0
tests.title: falls back to dpr 1 when dpr is 0
tests.scenario: Given viewport 1280x720 and dpr 0, When computeZoom runs, Then the result equals computeZoom(1280,720,1) = 2
tests.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/computeZoom.test.ts --testTimeout=10000

tests.name: tests/computeZoom.test.ts > computeZoom whole-number scaling > falls back to dpr 1 when dpr is -1
tests.title: falls back to dpr 1 when dpr is -1
tests.scenario: Given viewport 1280x720 and dpr -1, When computeZoom runs, Then the result equals computeZoom(1280,720,1) = 2
tests.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/computeZoom.test.ts --testTimeout=10000

tests.name: tests/computeZoom.test.ts > computeZoom whole-number scaling > falls back to dpr 1 when dpr is NaN
tests.title: falls back to dpr 1 when dpr is NaN
tests.scenario: Given viewport 1280x720 and dpr NaN, When computeZoom runs, Then the result equals computeZoom(1280,720,1) = 2
tests.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/computeZoom.test.ts --testTimeout=10000

tests.name: tests/computeZoom.test.ts > computeZoom whole-number scaling > falls back to dpr 1 when dpr is Infinity
tests.title: falls back to dpr 1 when dpr is Infinity
tests.scenario: Given viewport 1280x720 and dpr Infinity, When computeZoom runs, Then the result equals computeZoom(1280,720,1) = 2
tests.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/computeZoom.test.ts --testTimeout=10000

tests.name: tests/phaserConfig.test.ts > Phaser game config > uses the 480x270 native resolution
tests.title: uses the 480x270 native resolution
tests.scenario: Given the config module, When GAME_WIDTH/GAME_HEIGHT are read and buildGameConfig is called, Then they are 480 and 270 and the config has width 480 and height 270
tests.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/phaserConfig.test.ts tests/phaserHost.test.tsx --testTimeout=10000

tests.name: tests/phaserConfig.test.ts (5 existing tests)
tests.title: existing Phaser game config tests still pass with the 480x270 constants
tests.scenario: Given the 480x270 config, When the pre-existing config, zoom and createGame tests run, Then they pass
tests.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/phaserConfig.test.ts tests/phaserHost.test.tsx --testTimeout=10000

tests.name: tests/phaserHost.test.tsx (5 tests)
tests.title: PhaserHost tests pass with no literal 640x360 expectation
tests.scenario: Given the PhaserHost stubbed viewport, When the host runs, Then zoom expectations derived from computeZoom hold
tests.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/phaserConfig.test.ts tests/phaserHost.test.tsx --testTimeout=10000

tests.name: audit: no 640x360 literal expectation in tests/src
tests.title: no existing test assumes 640x360
tests.scenario: Given grep of tests and src for 640 and 360, Then no expectation asserts a 640x360 native size
tests.detail: Only hit: tests/phaserHost.test.tsx L155-169 uses a 640px viewport stub; expectations are computed via computeZoom, so no change needed.
